input.summary:
Implemented the complete Task Management API with the following files:

**src/event-bus.ts** — In-memory pub/sub EventBus class with `publish()` and `subscribe()`. Exports a singleton `eventBus` instance. Errors in subscribers are caught and logged to prevent cascade failures.

**src/services/user-service.ts** — UserService with `create`, `getById`, `getAll`, `update`, `delete`. Owns `Map<string, User>`. Exported as singleton `userService`.

**src/services/project-service.ts** — ProjectService with `create`, `getById`, `getAll`, `update`, `delete`, `addMember`, `removeMember`. Owns `Map<string, Project>`. Exported as singleton `projectService`.

**src/services/task-service.ts** — TaskService injected with EventBus. Implements `create`, `getById`, `getByProject`, `update`, `delete`, `assign` (publishes `task.assigned`), `changeStatus` (publishes `task.statusChanged`). Enforces forward-only status transitions: `todo → in-progress → done` via a `VALID_TRANSITIONS` lookup table.

**src/services/comment-service.ts** — CommentService injected with EventBus. Implements `create`, `getById`, `getByTask`, `delete`. Publishes `comment.added` with an enriched payload (taskTitle, authorName, taskAssigneeId) that is resolved by the router before the service call — respecting the no-direct-service-calls constraint.

**src/services/notification-service.ts** — NotificationService injected with EventBus. Subscribes to `task.assigned`, `task.statusChanged`, `comment.added` in its constructor. Creates appropriate notifications: assignee is notified on assignment, assignee on status change, assignee notified on comments (if different from author), author notified their comment posted. Exposes `getByUser` and `markAsRead`.

**src/router.ts** — Router class receiving all five services via constructor injection. Uses Node.js `http` module only. Parses URL pathname into segments for routing, reads JSON body via stream, and dispatches to the correct service method. For `POST /comments`, the router resolves `taskTitle`, `authorName`, and `taskAssigneeId` from their respective services before calling `commentService.create()` — the only place cross-service data resolution is permitted.

**src/main.ts** — Entry point. Wires the EventBus, all five services, and the Router, then starts an HTTP server on port 3000.

**src/demo.ts** — 16-step end-to-end demo covering: create users → create project → add members → create tasks → assign tasks → change status (valid transitions) → invalid status transitions (verified as errors) → add comments → check notifications → mark notifications read → read individual resources → update resources → remove member → delete comment. All 32 assertions pass.
